categories.main_business_segments: The company primarily operates in the natural gas industry, focusing on exploration, development, production, transmission, compression, and sales of natural gas. Key subsidiaries such as Zhonghai Wobang, Yonghe Weirun, Zhejiang Wojing, and Shanxi Wojin conduct these operations. The company also engages in downstream sales and pipeline transmission services, including gas compression and delivery to end users and national pipelines.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company employs advanced technologies in unconventional natural gas exploration and development, including deep coal seam gas and tight sandstone gas extraction. It utilizes integrated geological and engineering approaches, horizontal drilling, hydraulic fracturing, and remote unmanned well management. The company has established a technical system tailored to local geological conditions and has obtained numerous patents and certifications for its proprietary technologies.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers include urban residential users, industrial and chemical enterprises, transportation sectors, and power generation facilities. The company serves markets mainly within Shanxi Province and extends sales to other regions via national pipelines such as the West-East Gas Pipeline. Major customers account for over 80% of sales revenue, indicating a concentrated customer base.
categories.geographic_coverage: Operations are concentrated in Shanxi Province, particularly in the Shilou West Block within the Ordos Basin. The company also has subsidiaries and joint ventures in Zhejiang, Shanghai, Hainan, and Tibet. Its natural gas is supplied domestically across multiple provinces through national and regional pipeline networks.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the upstream and midstream segments of the natural gas supply chain, including exploration, production, and pipeline transmission. It also extends into downstream sales and distribution through its sales subsidiaries, integrating upstream resource development with downstream market delivery.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include expanding natural gas reserves and production capacity, optimizing multi-layer and multi-type gas resource development, and enhancing technological innovation in deep coal seam and tight gas extraction. The company emphasizes R&D in drilling, fracturing, and production optimization, supported by a dedicated New Energy Research Institute and high-tech committees. It also focuses on digitalization and automation to improve operational efficiency.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated mainly through the sale of natural gas produced from its exploration and development activities. Additional revenue streams include pipeline transmission and compression services, as well as downstream gas sales. The company also earns income from financial investments and government subsidies related to clean energy development.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company competes in a market dominated by major state-owned oil and gas enterprises such as PetroChina, Sinopec, and CNOOC. It positions itself as a significant regional player in Shanxi Province with competitive advantages in resource reserves, technology, and integrated supply chain capabilities. It also collaborates with industry leaders and leverages joint ventures to strengthen its market position.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 1.55 billion, representing a 14.19% increase year-over-year, driven by a 32% growth in natural gas sales volume. However, it incurred a net loss attributable to shareholders of RMB 710.95 million, mainly due to lower gas prices, increased financial expenses, and asset impairment. The company’s total assets reached RMB 8.36 billion, with ongoing investments in production capacity expansion and infrastructure.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its abundant natural gas reserves, advanced exploration and development technologies, and integrated upstream-to-downstream operations as key differentiators. Its technical expertise in unconventional gas extraction and multi-layer resource development enables efficient and cost-effective production. The company also leverages strategic acquisitions and pipeline connectivity to enhance supply reliability and market reach, supporting its commitment to clean energy and sustainable growth.
